AI Overview
Drift Boss is a free browser-based arcade driving game created by MarketJS in 2019 and playable on platforms like Poki, Coolmath Games, and Math Playground. 
How to Play
Driving: The car moves forward automatically without brakes.
Steering: Press and hold the left mouse button, spacebar, or screen to drift right.
Straightening: Release the button or screen to steer left and straighten out.
Objective: Stay on the narrow, guardrail-free floating track for as long as possible as speeds and difficulty increase. 
Boosters and Power-Ups
Before or during a run, you can use collected coins to pick up special boosters: 
Double Score: Doubles your distance-based score.
Car Insurance: Lets you restart from your position if you fall off the ledge once.
Coin Rush: Spawns extra coins across the level. 
Vehicles and Unlockables
Rides: Earn track coins and daily rewards to unlock different vehicles—ranging from a free green car up to a 5,000-coin fire truck (or utility trucks, taxis, and police cars) that feature better grip and handling.
